3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.2 (T3412 value), specifies the following: The MME shall include this IE during normal and combined tracking area updating procedure, and may include this IE during periodic tracking area updating procedure The MME shall include this IE if it includes the T3412 extended value IE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.20 (Non-3GPP NW provided policies), specifies the following: This IE is included if the network needs to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls (see 3GPP S 24.302 [48]). If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.21 (T3448 value), specifies the following: The network may include this IE if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports timer T3448

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.22 (Network policy), specifies the following: This IE is included if the network needs to indicate network policy information to the UE. If this IE is not included, then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.23 (T3447 value), specifies the following: The network may include T3447 value IE if - the UE has indicated support for service gap control in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages; and - the EMM context contains a service gap time value
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.24 (Ciphering key data), specifies the following: This IE is included if the network needs to send ciphering key data to the UE for ciphered broadcast assistance data

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.25 (UE radio capability ID), specifies the following: This IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.26 (UE radio capability ID deletion indication), specifies the following: This IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS and the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.27 (Negotiated WUS assistance information), specifies the following: The network shall include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE if - the UE supports WUS assistance - the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance; and - the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.28 (Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode), specifies the following: The network shall include the Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE if the UE has included the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.29 (Negotiated IMSI offset), specifies the following: The network shall include the Negotiated IMSI offset IE if the network supports paging timing collision control and the MUSIM UE has included the Requested IMSI offset IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.3 (GUTI), specifies the following: This IE may be included to assign a GUTI to a UE
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.30 (EPS additional request result), specifies the following: The network may include this IE to inform the UE about the result of additional request

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.31 (Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"), specifies the following: This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.32 (Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"), specifies the following: This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.4 (TAI list), specifies the following: This IE may be included to assign a TAI list to a UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.5 (EPS bearer context status), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the network wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.6 (Location area identification), specifies the following: This IE may be included to assign a new location area identification to a UE during a combined TA/LA update
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.7 (MS identity), specifies the following: This IE may be included to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE during a combined TA/LA update
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.8 (EMM cause), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services only
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.26.9 (T3402 value), specifies the following: This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3402

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.27 (Tracking area update complete), specifies the following: This message shall be sent by the UE to the network in response to a tracking area update accept message if a GUTI has been changed or a new TMSI has been assigned. See table 8.2.27.1 Message type: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE Direction: UE to network
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.28.2 (T3346 value), specifies the following: The MME may include this IE when the general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.28.3 (Extended EMM cause), specifies the following: This IE may be included by the network to indicate additional information associated with the EMM cause

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.28.4 (Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"), specifies the following: This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.28.5 (Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"), specifies the following: This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: The purposes of sending the tracking area update request by the UE to the network are described in clause 5.5.3.1. See table 8.2.29.1 Message type: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.10 (UE radio capability information update needed), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE radio capability information in the network needs to be updated
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.11 (EPS bearer context status), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active within the UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.12 (MS network capability), specifies the following: A UE supporting A/Gb mode or Iu mode shall include this IE, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.13 (Old location area identification), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE during a combined tracking area updating procedure if it has a valid location area identification
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.14 (TMSI status), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE during a combined tracking area updating procedure if it has no valid TMSI available

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.15 (Mobile station classmark 2), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN or supports vSRVCC to UTRAN (see 3GPP S 23.216 [8]), or if the UE is performing a combined tracking area updating procedure
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.16 (Mobile station classmark 3), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.17 (Supported Codecs), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN or supports vSRVCC to UTRAN to indicate its supported speech codecs for CS speech calls

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.18 (Additional update type), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE requests "SMS only" or CIoT EPS optimizations, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.19 (Voice domain preference and UE 's usage setting), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in WB-S1 mode if and only if the UE supports - CS fallback and SMS over SGs; or - if the UE is configured to support IMS voice, but does not support 1xCS fallback

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.2 (Non-current native NAS key set identifier), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE has a valid non-current native EPS security context when the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode or N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-CONNECTED mode and the UE uses a mapped EPS security context to protect the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.20 (Old GUTI type), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.21 (Device properties), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.22 (MS network feature support), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.23 (TMSI based NRI container), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if it has a valid TMSI
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.24 (T3324 value), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE to request the use of PSM
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.25 (T3412 extended value), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE to request a particular T3412 value if the T3324 value IE is included
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.26 (Extended DRX parameters), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE to request the use of eDRX
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.27 (UE additional security capability), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.28 (UE status), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE wants to provide the network with information concerning aspects of the current UE registration status which is used for interworking with 5GS

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.29 (Additional information requested), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and the UE needs to obtain new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.3 (GPRS ciphering key sequence number), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-IDLE mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI"

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.30 (N1 UE network capability), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports N1 mode and needs to indicate the supported CIoT network behaviour for 5GCN, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.31 (UE radio capability ID availability IE), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE in WB-S1 mode if the UE supports RACS and the UE has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.32 (DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode), specifies the following: This IE is included if the UE intends to use or change the UE specific DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode, except when the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.33 (Requested WUS assistance information), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE if it supports WUS assistance and it is not attaching for emergency bearer services

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.34 (Requested IMSI offset), specifies the following: The MUSIM UE may include this IE if the UE needs to indicate an IMSI offset value to the network as specified in 3GPP S 23.401 [10] that is used for deriving the paging occasion as specified in 3GPP S 36.304 [21]
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.35 (UE request type), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the MUSIM UE requests the release of the NAS signalling connection

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.36 (Paging restriction), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" in the UE request type IE and the UE requests the network to restrict paging
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.4 (Old P-TMSI signature), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the TIN indicates "P-TMSI" and the UE holds a valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.5 (Additional GUTI), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE a) if the TIN indicates "P-TMSI" and the UE holds a valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI; or b) if the UE performs an N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change and the UE holds a valid GUTI

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.6 (NonceUE), specifies the following: This IE is included if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in idle mode and the TIN is set to "P-TMSI"
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.7 (UE network capability), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.8 (Last visited registered TAI), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE holds a valid last visited registered TAI
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.29.9 (DRX parameter), specifies the following: This IE is included by the UE to indicate a change of UE specific DRX parameters to the network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.30 (Uplink NAS Transport), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network in order to carry an SMS message in encapsulated format. See table 8.2.30.1 Message type: UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT Direction: UE to network
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.33.2 (ESM message container), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE, if it wants to send an ESM message to the network
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.33.3 (NAS message container), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE, if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and has pending SMS messages to be sent
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.33.4 (EPS bearer context status), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE, if it wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active within the UE
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.33.5 (Device properties), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.33.6 (UE request type), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the MUSIM UE requests the release of the NAS signalling connection or rejects the paging request from the network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.33.7 (Paging restriction), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" or to "Rejection of paging" in the UE request type IE and the UE requests the network to restrict paging

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.34.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network in response to the SERVICE REQUEST message, the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message or the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message. See table 8.2.34.1 Message type: SERVICE ACCEPT Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.34.2 (EPS bearer context status), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the network wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.34.3 (T3448 value), specifies the following: The network may include this IE if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports timer T3448
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.34.4 (EPS additional request result), specifies the following: The network may include this IE to inform the UE about the result of additional request
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.3.2 (ESM message container), specifies the following: This IE is included to carry a single ESM message
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.3.3 (T3346 value), specifies the following: The MME may include this IE when the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.3.4 (T3402 value), specifies the following: This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3402
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.3.5 (Extended EMM cause), specifies the following: This IE may be included by the network to indicate additional information associated with the EMM cause

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.3.6 (Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"), specifies the following: This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.3.7 (Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"), specifies the following: This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network in order to perform an attach procedure. See table 8.2.4.1 Message type: ATTACH REQUEST Direction: UE to network
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.10 (Mobile station classmark 3), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.11 (Supported Codecs), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN or supports vSRVCC to UTRAN to indicate its supported speech codecs for CS speech calls
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.12 (Additional update type), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE requests "SMS only" or CIoT EPS optimizations

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.13 (Voice domain preference and UE 's usage setting), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in WB-S1 mode if and only if the UE supports - CS fallback and SMS over SGs; or - if the UE is configured to support IMS voice, but does not support 1xCS fallback
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.14 (Device properties), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.15 (Old GUTI type), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the type of identity in the EPS mobile identity IE is set to "GUTI"
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.16 (MS network feature support), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.17 (TMSI based NRI container), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE during a combined attach procedure if it has a valid TMSI
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.18 (T3324 value), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE to request the use of PSM
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.19 (T3412 extended value), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE to request a particular T3412 value if the T3324 value IE is included

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.2 (Old P-TMSI signature), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE holds a valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI, and the TIN either indicates "P-TMSI" or is deleted. If the UE is configured for "AttachWithIMSI" as specified in 3GPP S 24.368 [15A] or 3GPP S 31.102 [17] and is attaching in a new PLMN that is neither the registered PLMN nor in the list of equivalent PLMNs, the UE shall not include this IE
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.20 (Extended DRX parameters), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE to request the use of eDRX
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.21 (UE additional security capability), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.22 (UE status), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE wants to provide the network with information concerning aspects of the current UE registration status which is used for interworking with 5GS

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.23 (Additional information requested), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and the UE needs to obtain new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.24 (N1 UE network capability), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports N1 mode and needs to indicate the supported CIoT network behaviour for 5GCN

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.25 (UE radio capability ID availability IE), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE in WB-S1 mode if the UE supports RACS and the UE has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.26 (Requested WUS assistance information), specifies the following: The UE may include this IE if it supports WUS assistance and it is not attaching for emergency bearer services
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.27 (DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode), specifies the following: This IE is included if the UE intends to use the UE specific DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.28 (Requested IMSI offset), specifies the following: The MUSIM UE may include this IE if the UE needs to indicate an IMSI offset value to the network as specified in 3GPP S 23.401 [10] that is used for deriving the paging occasion as specified in 3GPP S 36.304 [21]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.3 (Additional GUTI), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the TIN indicates "P-TMSI" and the UE holds a valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI. If the UE is configured for "AttachWithIMSI" as specified in 3GPP S 24.368 [15A] or 3GPP S 31.102 [17] and is attaching in a new PLMN that is neither the registered PLMN nor in the list of equivalent PLMNs, the UE shall not include this IE
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.4 (Last visited registered TAI), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE holds a valid last visited registered TAI

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.5 (DRX parameter), specifies the following: This IE is included if UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or if the UE wants to indicate its UE specific DRX parameters to the network
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.6 (MS network capability), specifies the following: A UE supporting A/Gb mode or Iu mode shall include this IE to indicate its capabilities to the network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.7 (Old location area identification), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE during a combined attach procedure if it has a valid location area identification
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.8 (TMSI status), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE during combined attach procedure if it has no valid TMSI available

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.4.9 (Mobile station classmark 2), specifies the following: This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN or supports vSRVCC to UTRAN (see 3GPP S 23.216 [8]), or if the UE is performing a combined attach procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.5.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to indicate that authentication of the network has failed. See table 8.2.5.1 Message type: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.5.2 (Authentication failure parameter), specifies the following: This IE shall be sent if and only if the EMM cause was #21 "synch failure". It shall include the response to the authentication challenge from the USIM, which is made up of the AUTS parameter (see 3GPP S 33.102 [18])

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.6 (Authentication reject), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to the UE to indicate that the authentication procedure has failed and that the UE shall abort all activities. See table 8.2.6.1 Message type: AUTHENTICATION REJECT Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.8 (Authentication response), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to deliver a calculated authentication response to the network. See table 8.2.8.1 Message type: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.9.2 (CLI), specifies the following: The network shall send this IE if it was received via SGs. It contains the identification of the calling line for the mobile terminating call in the CS domain, which triggered the paging via SGs

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.9.3 (SS Code), specifies the following: The network shall send this IE if it was received via SGs. It contains information on the supplementary service transaction in the CS domain, which triggered the paging via SGs

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.9.4 (LCS indicator), specifies the following: The network shall send this IE if it was received via SGs. It indicates that the paging was triggered by a terminating LCS request in the CS domain

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.2.9.5 (LCS client identity), specifies the following: The network shall send this IE if received via SGs. It contains information related to the requestor of the terminating LCS request in the CS domain

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to request the modification of a dedicated bearer resource, or to request re-negotiation of header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context if the network has previously indicated support of Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization. See table 8.3.10.1 Message type: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.2 (Required traffic flow QoS), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE requests a change of QoS for the indicated traffic flows and does not request to release all bearer resources for the EPS bearer context
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.3 (ESM cause), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.4 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.5 (Device properties), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.6 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.7 (Header compression configuration), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message if a) the UE wishes to re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context and both the UE and the network supports Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression; or b) to negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context after an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode when both the UE and the network support control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression, and the UE is operating in single-registration mode and has received the interworking without N26 interface indicator set to "interworking without N26 interface not supported" from the network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.8 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.10.9 (Extended EPS QoS), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message only if the UE wishes to transmit the maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element in clause 9.9.4.3

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.11.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to acknowledge deactivation of the EPS bearer context requested in the corresponding Deactivate EPS bearer context request message. See table 8.3.11.1 Message type: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.11.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.11.4 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12A (ESM dummy message), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE or the network included in an ESM message container information element during an attach procedure, if the UE does not request for PDN connection. See table 8.3.12A.1 Message type: ESM DUMMY MESSAGE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to request deactivation of an active EPS bearer context. See table 8.3.12.1 Message type: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12.3 (T3396 value), specifies the following: The network may include this IE if the ESM cause is #26 "insufficient resources"

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12.4 (WLAN offload indication), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message when the network wishes to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s), as specified in clause 9.9.4.18. If the MME wishes to deactivate all EPS bearer contexts of a PDN connection, MME shall not include this IE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12.5 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.12.6 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.13 (ESM information request), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to the UE to request the UE to provide ESM information, i.e. protocol configuration options or APN or both. See table 8.3.13.1 Message type: ESM INFORMATION REQUEST Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.14.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network in response to an ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message and provides the requested ESM information. See table 8.3.14.1 Message type: ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.14.2 (Access point name), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to request network connectivity as defined by a certain access point name during the attach procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.14.3 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message when, during the attach procedure, the UE wishes to transmit security protected (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network, and a) the UE is in WB-S1 mode b) the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet; and c) the requested APN is not for UAS services This IE shall be included if a) the UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter b) the UE is in WB-S1 mode c) the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet; and d) the requested APN is not for UAS services This IE shall not be included if the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included in the message

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.14.4 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message when, during the attach procedure, the UE wishes to transmit security protected (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network, and a) the UE is in NB-S1 mode b) the requested PDN Type is non-IP or Ethernet; or c) the requested APN is for UAS services This IE shall be included if a) the UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter, the UE is in NB-S1 mode and the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet; or b) the UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter, the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet, and the requested APN is for UAS services This IE shall not be included if the Protocol configuration options IE is included in the message

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.15 (ESM status), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network or the UE to pass information on the status of the indicated EPS bearer context and report certain error conditions (e.g. as listed in clause 7). See table 8.3.15.1 Message type: ESM STATUS

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.16.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.16.3 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.16.4 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.17.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE or the network to reject a modification of an active EPS bearer context. See table 8.3.17.1 Message type: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.17.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.17.3 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.17.4 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18A (Notification), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to inform the UE about events which are relevant for the upper layer using an EPS bearer context or having requested a procedure transaction. See table 8.3.18A.1 Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to the UE to request modification of an active EPS bearer context, or to request re-negotiation of header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context if the UE has previously indicated support of Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization. See table 8.3.18.1 Message type: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.10 (WLAN offload indication), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message when the network wishes to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s), as specified in clause 9.9.4.18

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.11 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.12 (Header compression configuration), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message if the network wishes to re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context and both the UE and the network support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.13 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.14 (Extended APN-AMBR), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message only if at least one of the APN-AMBR values has been changed by the network and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.15 (Extended EPS QoS), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message only if the network wishes to transmit the maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the UE and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element in clause 9.9.4.3

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.2 (New EPS QoS), specifies the following: When the EPS QoS of the EPS bearer context is modified, the network shall include the modified EPS QoS assigned to the EPS bearer context
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.3 (TFT), specifies the following: This IE provides the UE with packet filters

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.4 (New QoS), specifies the following: If the UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both and when the corresponding R99 QoS of the EPS bearer context is modified, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both shall include the corresponding R99 QoS parameter values of a PDP context

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.5 (Negotiated LLC SAPI), specifies the following: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and when the negotiated LLC SAPI is modified, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.6 (Radio priority), specifies the following: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and when the radio priority is modified, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.7 (Packet flow identifier), specifies the following: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.8 (APN-AMBR), specifies the following: This IE is included when the APN-AMBR has been changed by the network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.18.9 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.19.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.19.3 (Back-off timer value), specifies the following: The network may include this IE if the ESM cause is not #28 "unknown PDN type", #50 "PDN type IPv4 only allowed", #51 "PDN type IPv6 only allowed", #54 "PDN connection does not exist", #57 "PDN type IPv4v6 only allowed", #58 "PDN type non IP only allowed", #61 "PDN type Ethernet only allowed", or #65 "maximum number of EPS bearers reached", to request a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.19.4 (Re-attempt indicator), specifies the following: The network may include this IE only if the ESM cause value is #28 "unknown PDN type", #50 "PDN type IPv4 only allowed", #51 "PDN type IPv6 only allowed", #57 "PDN type IPv4v6 only allowed", #58 "PDN type non IP only allowed", #61 "PDN type Ethernet only allowed", or #66 "requested APN not supported in current RAT and PLMN combination", or if the network includes the Back-off timer value IE and the ESM cause value is not #26 "insufficient resources"

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.19.5 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.1.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to acknowledge activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context associated with the same PDN address(es) and APN as an already active EPS bearer context. See table 8.3.1.1 Message type: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.1.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.1.3 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.1.4 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to initiate establishment of a PDN connection. See table 8.3.20.1 Message type: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.2 (ESM information transfer flag), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message sent during the attach procedure if the UE has protocol configuration options that need to be transferred security protected or wishes to provide an access point name for the PDN connection to be established during the attach procedure

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.3 (Access point name), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to request network connectivity as defined by a certain access point name. This IE shall not be included when the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message is included in an ATTACH REQUEST message or if the request type indicates "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services" or "RLOS"

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.4 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network, and a) the UE is in WB-S1 mode b) the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet; and c) the requested APN is not for UAS services This IE shall be included if a) the UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter b) the UE is in WB-S1 mode c) the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet; and d) the requested APN is not for UAS services This IE shall not be included if the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included in the message
3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.5 (Device properties), specifies the following: The UE shall include this IE if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.6 (NBIFOM container), specifies the following: This information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility, see 3GPP S 24.161 [36]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.7 (Header compression configuration), specifies the following: The UE shall include the Header compression configuration IE if - the PDN type value of the PDN type IE is set to IPv4 or IPv6 or IPv4v6 - the UE indicates "Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" in the UE network capability IE of the ATTACH REQUEST message; and - the UE supports header compression

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.20.8 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE shall be included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network, and a) the UE is in NB-S1 mode b) the requested PDN Type is non-IP or Ethernet; or c) the requested APN is for UAS services This IE shall be included if a) the UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter, the UE is in NB-S1 mode and the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet; or b) the UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter, the requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet, and the requested APN is for UAS services This IE shall not be included if the Protocol configuration options IE is included in the message

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.21.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to the UE to reject release of a PDN connection. See table 8.3.21.1 Message type: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT Direction: network to UE

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.21.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.21.3 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.22.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to initiate release of a PDN connection. See table 8.3.22.1 Message type: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.22.2 (Protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.22.3 (Extended protocol configuration options), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message when the UE wishes to transmit (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network and the extended protocol configuration options is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection (see clause 6.6.1.1)

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.23.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the UE to the network to report connection or disconnection of remote UE(s). See table 8.3.23.1 Message type: REMOTE UE REPORT Direction: UE to network

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.23.2 (Remote UE Context Connected), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message by the UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay to provide the network with newly connected remote UE information as specified in 3GPP S 23.303 [31]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.23.3 (Remote UE Context Disconnected), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message by the UE acting as ProSe UE-to-Network Relay to provide the network with disconnected remote UE information as specified in 3GPP S 23.303 [31]

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.23.4 (ProSe Key Management Function Address), specifies the following: This IE is included in the message by the UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay to provide the network with the address of the ProSe Key Management Function associated with the remote UEs connected to or disconnected from the ProSe UE-to-network relay

3GPP TS 24.301, clause 8.3.24.1 (Message definition), specifies the following: This message is sent by the network to the UE to acknowledge receipt of a Remote UE report message. See table 8.3.24.1 Message type: REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE Direction: network to UE
